title: Book 1 — Clio, Chapter 126
paragraphs: The Persians, who had long resented Median rule, now had a leader. They eagerly set about winning their freedom. When Astyages heard what Cyrus was doing, he sent a messenger to summon him. Cyrus told the messenger to report back that he would be with Astyages sooner than Astyages wished. When Astyages heard this, he armed the entire Median nation. As if heaven had robbed him of his senses, he appointed Harpagos as their general—forgetting what he had done to the man. When Harpagos took the field with the Median army and engaged the Persians, some of the Medes fought, but those in the conspiracy deserted to the Persians. Most of the rest, seeing what was happening, deliberately fought badly and fled.
